name: mspoint-assist
description: MSPoint Assist — AI support agent for small business websites, built on Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, Vectorize and D1.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.vectorize:ensure: wrangler vectorize get mspoint-assist >/dev/null 2>&1 || wrangler vectorize create mspoint-assist --dimensions=768 --metric=cosine
scripts.deploy:ci: npm run vectorize:ensure && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
